title: Cascader
whenToUse:
- When you need to select from a set of associated data set. Such as province/city/district, company level, things classification.
- When selecting from a large data set, with multi-stage classifications separated for easy selection.
- Chooses cascade items in one float layer for better user experience.

examples.description: Cascade selection box for selecting province/city/district.

examples.name: Default value
examples.description: Specifies default value by an array.

examples.name: Custom trigger
examples.description: Separate trigger button and result.

examples.name: Hover
examples.description: Hover to expand sub menu, click to select option.

examples.description: Disable option by specifying the `disabled` property in `options`.

examples.name: Change on select
examples.description: Allows the selection of only parent options.

examples.name: Multiple
examples.description: Select multiple options. Disable the `checkbox` by adding the `disableCheckbox` property and selecting a specific item. The style of the disable can be modified by the className.

examples.name: ShowCheckedStrategy
examples.description: Shows a selected item in a box using `showCheckedStrategy`.

examples.name: Size
examples.description: Cascade selection box of different sizes.

examples.name: Custom render
examples.description: For instance, add an external link after the selected value.

examples.name: Search
examples.description: Search and select options directly.

examples.description: Load options lazily with `loadData`.

examples.name: Custom Field Names
examples.description: Custom field names.

examples.name: Prefix and Suffix
examples.description: Use `prefix` to customize the prefix content, use `suffixIcon` to customize the selection box suffix icon, and use `expandIcon` to customize the current item expand icon.

examples.name: Custom dropdown
examples.description: Customize the dropdown menu via `popupRender`.

examples.name: Placement
examples.description: You can manually specify the position of the popup via `placement`.

examples.name: Variants
examples.description: Variants of Cascader, there are four variants: `outlined` `filled` `borderless` and `underlined`.

examples.name: Status
examples.description: Add status to Cascader with `status`, which could be `error` or `warning`.

examples.description: You can customize the semantic dom style of Cascader by passing objects/functions through `classNames` and `styles`.
